note: Branch A leads (must clear branch_a_threshold on its own top pick). Branch B supports (must not contradict A - B's probability for A's predicted class must clear branch_b_threshold). Otherwise -> unknown. Two pre-filters also run BEFORE the model, combined with OR: green_ratio (leaf-colored content) and leaf_shape (a single coherent foreground blob). An image is rejected as unknown WITHOUT running the model only if BOTH pre-filters fail.
